hook.text: You can't test everything. A login page and an 'about us' page carry different risks. Prioritize wisely.

buildup.text: Risk-based thinking focuses testing effort on features where failure would cause the most damage.

discovery.text: Risk = probability of failure × impact of failure. High risk items get tested first and most thoroughly.

twist.text: Low-risk features still need some coverage. Ignoring them entirely creates blind spots that surprise you later.

climax.text: A risk matrix helps teams visually prioritize: critical paths get deep testing, stable areas get light checks.

punchline.text: Test where it hurts most. You can't cover everything equally.
